note: Whole-dish totals are summed from raw ingredient weights. Water lost in cooking changes weight, not the total energy or macronutrients, so the factor is 1.0 for these; USDA retention factors (public domain) matter for vitamins and minerals, which are not used yet. Oil is counted in full (nothing assumed left in the pan). CF-0.2.0: the six extra nutrients also use 1.0, meaning no loss in cooking is assumed. Boiling can wash some potassium and sodium into the water, so this slightly over-counts them. That is the safe direction for a maximum limit; a reviewer may refine it with USDA retention factors.
